stop: Stop when the 1000 plateless T2 test episodes and the 1000-episode 7-condition ablation are simulated or the owner cap is reached.

groups.name: t2-plateless
groups.pilot: stress 2026-11-25 (scripts/heavy.sh, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4, 4070 host, CPU only): python -m cfcap.runner t2_eval --shard 0 --n-shards 1 --out /tmp/pl --mode simulate --plate plateless --split test --episodes 10 --per-unit 10: 1.89 s/episode (18 candidates/episode, labels + parent v2 obs), unit of 100 episodes ~190 s at 4 threads; RSS < 1 GB, VRAM 0.
groups.purpose: Simulate 1000 plateless T2 test episodes (same specs as the T1 plateless test split) so the misspecification result is reported per plate state.

groups.name: t2-ablation
groups.pilot: stress 2026-11-25 (scripts/heavy.sh, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=4, 4070 host, CPU only): python -m cfcap.runner t2_eval --shard 0 --n-shards 1 --out /tmp/abl --mode simulate --split test --episodes 6 --per-unit 6 --no-obs --conds base,compliance,load_transfer,aniso,aniso_mu,all-aniso_mu,all: 10.6 s/episode (7 conditions, 18 candidates/episode), unit of 25 episodes ~265 s at 4 threads; RSS < 1 GB, VRAM 0.
groups.purpose: Re-run 1000 plated T2 test episodes under each of the 7 T2 effect conditions to attribute the T1 to T2 certificate shift to its cause at episode scale.
